name: viberaven
description: Test what breaks when two users act at once, on real PostgreSQL, and review Supabase migrations for RLS and grant gaps.

interface.longDescription:
VibeRaven tests your app's database the way real traffic hits it: two users at the same moment. Paste your Supabase or PostgreSQL migration, or a public GitHub repo at a commit, and say what must stay true, for example "at most 2 bookings per event". VibeRaven runs every order of the two users' steps on real PostgreSQL 18.6 and shows the exact order that breaks the rule, the rows it leaves behind, and a fix. Each result has a replay token, so the same test gives the same answer.

It also reviews migrations for row-level security and grant gaps, explains VibeRaven findings, and answers Vercel and Supabase launch questions with source links.

Limits: tests run on an offline PostgreSQL instance built from the SQL you supply, not your live database; bounded to a capped number of orders and stated when capped; public repositories only; no account needed. For tests inside your own repo, run npx -y viberaven race.
capabilities: Test two users at once on real PostgreSQL
defaultPrompt: Can two users book the last seat at the same time? Here is my migration.
Test whether two people can redeem the same single-use invite at once.
Can two shoppers buy the last item? Stock must never go below zero.
